listSource: Competition starter trophy list; 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden in aggregate.
hiddenFlagsNote: The starter includes the aggregate hidden count but no per-trophy hidden flags. Individual hidden status is not inferred; spoiler mode instead masks all unearned story trophies.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn each of the other 54 single-player trophies; the platinum is the capstone, not a separate activity. Keep the small chapter-one caution below on your radar, then finish story, checklist work and the remaining side strands.
trophies.verdictNote: Unlocks with the rest of the list; no online trophies are required.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is automatic in the opening story mission, Gone Fishing. Play through the mission to its completion; no optional objective or medal is required.
trophies.verdictNote: Story progression in Chapter 1; the source describes it as an automatic unlock.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Continue the main story into Chapter 2. PowerPyx identifies the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, as the point after which this automatic chapter trophy unlocks.
trophies.verdictNote: Automatic story progression; not described as missable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Advance the main story into Chapter 3 and complete Welcome to Vice City. The guide lists this as an automatic chapter milestone.
trophies.verdictNote: Automatic story progression; no side objective is listed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 opening missions Ocean Beach and Another Life mark the completion of Chapter 3 for this automatic unlock.
trophies.verdictNote: Automatic story milestone as the next chapter begins.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's final main mission, Starting From Zero. The trophy guide reports an automatic unlock at that mission's end.
trophies.verdictNote: Automatic story progression; keep a manual save if you want a replay point because the source reports no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final main mission. PowerPyx identifies the closing Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero, as the automatic unlock point, even though the broader walkthrough lists later Chapter 5 story entries.
trophies.verdictNote: Story progression milestone. The exact chapter label differs between the trophy page and the walkthrough; the mission name is the source's stated trigger.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. The trophy is described as automatic during that story mission.
trophies.verdictNote: Automatic story mission unlock.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. PowerPyx marks this as automatic during the main mission; no optional heist medal is required.
trophies.verdictNote: Automatic story mission unlock.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. This is listed as an automatic story trophy.
trophies.verdictNote: Automatic story mission unlock.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, the Chapter 4 main mission. The trophy guide calls this an automatic unlock during the mission.
trophies.verdictNote: Automatic story mission unlock.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. The trophy is reported as an automatic story unlock.
trophies.verdictNote: Automatic story mission unlock.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. The story walkthrough and trophy guide list it as a main-mission milestone.
trophies.verdictNote: Story mission milestone; PowerPyx calls the unlock automatic.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress → Stats → 100% Completion and work through that checklist. The verified checklist calls for a broad but partial sweep: examples include 100 optional tasks, all 39 gang operations, all 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone trials, 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 200 base vehicles and 100 animals. Story progress counts toward it; the source says its requirements remain available in free roam.
trophies.verdictNote: The 100% checklist unlocks after the story; the source says nothing on that checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. The trophy guide recommends mixing categories and notes under-bridge flights are quick; progress is tracked under Progress → Activities → Stunts.
trophies.verdictNote: Choose any 250; the source places all stunt cleanup in free roam.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine tracked activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race (or race challenge / drone race), and a stunt. The activity tracker is in Touchpad → Progress → Activities; most types surface through story play or map markers.
trophies.verdictNote: The source says these can be completed while working on the wider list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 range challenges. The checklist confirms 42 of 42 are needed for 100% as well. Use Progress → Activities → Shooting Ranges to check the remaining medals; the full location and medal walkthrough is linked from the source guide.
trophies.verdictNote: All range challenges remain available for cleanup; no time limit is stated.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. The 100% checklist confirms 42 time trials in total across those locations; its source guide links the location walkthrough. Track the activity from Progress → Activities → Top Fun Drones.
trophies.verdictNote: The challenge set is part of the post-story checklist and no missable window is reported.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races rather than repeating one event. Progress toward race activities can be checked in the Progress menu; 30 unique wins are also part of the 100% checklist, so that larger sweep will cover this target.
trophies.verdictNote: The source presents races as free-roam activities with extra events beyond the trophy count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1's Feng Shui (Meet Cal), wait for Cal's message marking a purple fishing activity west of Key Lento. Complete the challenge there to finish his strand and claim the trophy.
trophies.verdictNote: Cal's activity becomes available after a story introduction; the source says side content can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one video game. Three can be launched from the controller at home; Bang For Your Buck is available at arcade machines. The source says the home options are accessible from Chapter 1 and again after the story.
trophies.verdictNote: Pick any one game; the source reports post-story access.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: As Lucia, start Andy's strand when her call and Belville address arrive in Chapter 3. Complete its five linked missions in sequence, ending with Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse). PowerPyx says the strand remains available after the story.
trophies.verdictNote: Chapter 3 Lucia questline; can be completed in post-story free roam.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, wait for Kenton's call and follow his Key Lento marker. Search the marked shipwrecks, recover their underwater treasures and return them; the strand asks for seven wrecks. He temporarily disappears after Chapter 1, then returns in Chapter 2–3. The source confirms post-story access.
trophies.verdictNote: Temporary chapter lock only; PowerPyx explicitly says Kenton returns and the strand is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, visit the Thrillbilly Mudclub marker in Kelly County. Finish Billy's five missions, ending with Hometown Heroes. The source says this optional line stays open after the story.
trophies.verdictNote: Chapter 2 introduction; cleanup remains available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish any eight qualifying stranger strands. PowerPyx confirms strands for Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count, while several trophy questlines (including Andy, Billy and Tyrone) do not. Use the trophy tracker to check qualifying progress; the open-world strands remain after the story.
trophies.verdictNote: Pick eight qualifying lines; not every optional chain counts.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, use the Key Cloner and deliver the requested sports cars to Randy. The list contains 16 models; use Map → Robberies → Randy's Wish List to check entries and scan cars with Waink before driving them to his garage.
trophies.verdictNote: Randy's Wish List unlocks in Chapter 3 and remains available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, switch to Jason and take out the purple Synthetic Lab markers for Tyrone's Take Out Kitty Litter task. Destroy enough labs to unlock his final mission, Spin On This.
trophies.verdictNote: Jason-only introduction after Chapter 3; PowerPyx says this content remains open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete the 18 meditation spots across Leonida; call your partner and meditate with both characters at a spot when possible, which the source says counts twice. Potential missable: during Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, speak with Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to Jason's balcony meditation prompt. PowerPyx confirms this event becomes unavailable after Chapter 1, but explicitly says whether it is required for the trophy is still unconfirmed.
trophies.verdictNote: Potential missable only: perform the Chapter 1 home meditation as insurance. Requirement status is unresolved in the source; do not treat this as a confirmed lockout.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, play as Jason and respond to Bret's message in Lummox County. Complete Veteran Hunted, then take his marked Target Deck hunts and bring the requested animal back. The route is confirmed; PowerPyx says the exact animal that triggers this trophy is still unconfirmed, so no specific target is claimed here.
trophies.verdictNote: Questline method confirmed; the exact trophy-triggering animal remains unknown in the cited guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish all cards in any three sets. The map has 18 named sets; track discovered cards under Progress → Collections → Collectible Cards. Use the linked card-set location guide for a route; this field guide does not claim unverified individual card locations.
trophies.verdictNote: Any three sets count; the source treats the collectibles as free-roam cleanup.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different objects or locations with the Waink app. The verified guide names landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags as sources of scans; any 100 count, so mix types and watch the collection counter rather than repeating a spot.
trophies.verdictNote: More scan targets exist than the trophy needs; use the in-game tracker for the running total.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 available challenges. Track the checkmarks in Progress → Challenges; leave this for cleanup so other trophy work can fill some of the total, then choose the easiest remaining tasks.
trophies.verdictNote: All 80 are available from the start according to the source; 50 is below the 70 needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner, reach a four-star Wanted Level and escape beyond the red heat zone. PowerPyx recommends the train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a practical hiding route. Large bank-vault robberies in Chapter 4 also create a four-star escape opportunity.
trophies.verdictNote: Partner free roam unlocks in Chapter 2; the source also expects this to come naturally during bank cleanup.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, call your partner and rob three stores in sequence while keeping the active wanted level throughout. The source's reliable setup is the three north Vice City jewelry shops after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; loot enough in each to ensure it registers, then wait for the delayed trophy pop.
trophies.verdictNote: Requires partner free roam in Chapter 2 and the source's suggested jewelry setup in Chapter 3; not missable.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Use Waink to scan unfamiliar vehicles as they pass on a busy road. A scan is enough; you do not need to drive each one. Continue to 200 base-model scans if aiming for the 100% checklist and check totals in Progress → Vehicles.
trophies.verdictNote: Vehicles appear across the open world; the source says scanning can be done during story or cleanup.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: While aiming a firearm, activate Combat Focus and defeat or incapacitate five enemies before that single use ends. The source suggests building Focus first, extending it with Adrenaline, then tackling a gang operation with body armor and an accurate automatic rifle. Police, soldiers and civilians may not count.
trophies.verdictNote: An open-world combat task; the source notes Focus improves through several activities.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, take a large passenger plane connected to a terminal boarding bridge, enter the cockpit and take off. The guide singles out the E3/E4 departure area and says to fly about 1 km away from the airport for the delayed unlock; a plane parked elsewhere on the airfield does not meet its method.
trophies.verdictNote: The airport remains accessible for free-roam cleanup.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino at Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the southwest edge of Mariana County. The source points to the tanks on the south side of the base; take one and fire on enemies to trigger the trophy.
trophies.verdictNote: Open-world vehicle challenge; no story window is reported.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies. Enter through a back door without triggering the alarm, use the safe code, and disable the alarm and security footage in the back room before leaving. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is the source's suggested location.
trophies.verdictNote: Jewelry robberies unlock during Chapter 3 and are not time-limited.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Start Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to learn vault robberies. Follow a security van to a large bank, enter while the guard opens the vault, take the cash and escape. Repeat at five different vaults; the source says the 100% checklist requires all eight.
trophies.verdictNote: Vault access arrives late in the story, but the source describes the robberies as endgame cleanup.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 bank-vault introduction is the low-friction route: tail the armored security truck, take the cash when the guard carries it into the vault, then get clear of the red heat zone. The guide also describes an earlier option to stop a truck, breach its rear with a sticky bomb and escape the police search area.
trophies.verdictNote: Can be earned through a later story-linked activity or an open-world ambush.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal all map fog. PowerPyx recommends using a plane to sweep blacked-out areas until the full map is visible; there is no stated collectible or chapter gate for the discovery itself.
trophies.verdictNote: Map exploration is available during free roam.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Complete one Illegal Operation for each of the nine gangs. Gang Operations appear as yellow map markers as you approach; many also surface through story progress. Track each gang's operation count under Progress → Gangs. The 100% checklist's 39 total operations will exceed this requirement.
trophies.verdictNote: The source says operations respawn if a key item was missed, though reappearance takes time.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing beside the bar. PowerPyx describes that exact spot-and-drink sequence for the unlock.
trophies.verdictNote: A free-roam hidden activity; no missable condition is reported.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After unlocking the Key Cloner in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, steal the blue Banshee from the showroom south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. PowerPyx notes the trophy is specific to that car and may pop after you reach the street.
trophies.verdictNote: The showroom and car can be revisited after the required tool unlock.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, collect its three marked valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun in the northeast corner and the office safe (the source gives 0300 as a code). Escape the police for the trophy. This is also the source's Chapter 2 Hit Kingpin Bowling location.
trophies.verdictNote: If an item is missed, PowerPyx says the operation can respawn; the items need not all be taken in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength to maximum. After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner and work out together at a fitness club; the source says the inactive partner trains in parallel while you exercise. Check each character's Strength in the character progress screen.
trophies.verdictNote: The partner requirement opens in Chapter 2; fitness work can continue in free roam.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Reach 500 actions that affect Criminal Profile. Turn on the profile notifications in Settings → UI → HUD Notifications to see qualifying changes. The source says normal robberies and encounters add progress over time; avoid intentionally pushing the permanent Irredeemable profile just to farm it.
trophies.verdictNote: The source expects this to progress naturally while doing other trophies.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: After Chapter 3's Credit Check unlocks Payday Loan robberies, return as Lucia alone to the same Little Cuba loan shop used in the Prologue. Rob it again, escape the police and keep running on foot; the source warns that driving away does not trigger this version of the trophy.
trophies.verdictNote: The repeat robbery becomes available after Credit Check and the location remains open.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Visit the road northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 a.m., alone. If a blinking car appears, follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach the abducted woman and offer help, then return with her to the roadside car. The source notes the encounter is random; leave and circle back if it does not spawn.
trophies.verdictNote: Random encounter, not a missable; repeat the nighttime visit until it appears.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride a motorcycle through a crowded area and kick pedestrians from the moving bike. PowerPyx's method is to land ten kicks within 60 seconds; busy Vice City or Ocean Beach streets make targets easier to find.
trophies.verdictNote: Open-world action with no chapter restriction reported.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 3's Credit Check unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, rob Banks or Payday Loans and sell Marked Bills to a Fence. Yasmani is the source's best-paying contact. The total accumulates across sales; later large-bank vaults can pay up to $205,000 in one run.
trophies.verdictNote: Marked-bill laundering unlocks at Credit Check; the bank checklist supplies repeatable post-story opportunities.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across shops. PowerPyx suggests high-cost purchases such as weapons, vehicle modifications and tattoos to build the amount quickly; the total is across purchases, not one store.
trophies.verdictNote: A cumulative spending target; no missable shop purchase is required.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2's Daily Driver, buy all eight purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. The source lists a combined price of $160,000; story garages do not count toward the eight purchases.
trophies.verdictNote: Garages unlock after Daily Driver and remain purchasable for free-roam cleanup.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2's Moses mission installs Scooter Bros, buy garages for enough parking capacity, then take eligible stolen vehicles to Moses' garage and choose Respray → Register. Standard Tracker vehicles can also be registered at Pay 'n' Sprays after their Chapter 3 unlock. The source suggests inexpensive cars and bikes to limit fees.
trophies.verdictNote: App access unlocks with Moses; garage space and registration are the practical constraints.
